data.title: Steam above the stalls

memoryNodes.cue: The vendor lays out rolls beside the honey.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 摊主把小面包摆在蜂蜜旁。

memoryNodes.cue: The coat is not right for a cold November walk.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 外套不适合十一月寒冷天气里步行。

data.situation:
When Lin's hour at the gate ended, she followed the smell of warm bread into the courtyard. A vendor was laying out rolls beside jars of honey. The market had a varied range of goods: second-hand coats, handmade cards, vegetables and small wooden toys. Between the colour of the cloth stalls, the sound of a violin and the steam above the soup, the visit became a sensory experience before Lin bought anything. Today’s soup and bread
Vegetable soup: £3
Bread roll: 80p
Our modestly priced lunch uses vegetables from the nearby farm. Please ask about ingredients before ordering. Maya: Shall we hire a big food van next year?
Lin: I saw one price this morning. It was prohibitively expensive for our budget.
Maya: I thought the quote was extortionate too. The vendors here are already doing a good job.
Lin: Yes. I'd rather give them more space. At the next table, Lin picked up a light cotton coat. It was attractive but unsuitable for the cold walk home in November. She put it back and pulled her own wool coat closer. A loaf of bread and a warm lunch would do for today. Behind her, the violin began another tune.

readingBlocks.en: When Lin's hour at the gate ended, she followed the smell of warm bread into the courtyard. A vendor was laying out rolls beside jars of honey. The market had a varied range of goods: second-hand coats, handmade cards, vegetables and small wooden toys. Between the colour of the cloth stalls, the sound of a violin and the steam above the soup, the visit became a sensory experience before Lin bought anything.
readingBlocks.zh: 在院门帮忙的一小时结束后，林循着热面包的香味走进院子。一位摊主正把小面包摆在蜂蜜罐旁。集市货物种类多样：二手外套、手工卡片、蔬菜和小木玩具。布料摊的色彩、小提琴的声音和汤上方的热气，让林尚未买任何东西，便有了丰富的感官体验。

readingBlocks.title: Soup and bread

readingBlocks.en:
Maya: Shall we hire a big food van next year?
Lin: I saw one price this morning. It was prohibitively expensive for our budget.
Maya: I thought the quote was extortionate too. The vendors here are already doing a good job.
Lin: Yes. I'd rather give them more space.
readingBlocks.zh:
玛雅：明年租一辆大餐车怎么样？
林：我今早看了一个报价。按我们的预算，贵得根本租不起。
玛雅：我也觉得报价高得离谱。这里的摊主已经做得很好了。
林：是的。我宁愿给他们更多空间。

readingBlocks.en: At the next table, Lin picked up a light cotton coat. It was attractive but unsuitable for the cold walk home in November. She put it back and pulled her own wool coat closer. A loaf of bread and a warm lunch would do for today. Behind her, the violin began another tune.
readingBlocks.zh: 下一张桌边，林拿起一件轻薄棉外套。它很好看，却不适合十一月走冷风里的回家路。她放下外套，裹紧自己的羊毛外套。今天有一条面包和一顿热午饭，就够了。身后的小提琴又开始一首曲子。

glossary.note: 卖货的人；本例为集市摊主。
glossary.example: The vendor lays out bread beside jars of honey.
glossary.exampleZh: 摊主把面包摆在蜂蜜罐旁。

externalEvidence.definition: someone who promotes or exchanges goods or services for money

glossary.note: 形容具有多种类型，不是vary的动作命令。
glossary.example: The market has a varied range of goods.

glossary.note: 搭配涉及视听嗅味触等感受；不是把所有感官都强制写进一个句子。
glossary.example: The colours, music and warm bread make the market a rich sensory experience.
glossary.exampleZh: 色彩、音乐和热面包，让集市成为丰富的感官体验。

glossary.note: modestly priced整块为价格适中或不高；不采用谦虚说话的WordNet义。
glossary.example: The soup is modestly priced at three pounds.
glossary.exampleZh: 汤定价三英镑，价格不高。

externalEvidence.findingZh: 用于价格时表示不很昂贵；WordNet谦虚义不匹配。

glossary.note: 带强烈评价，表示过分昂贵；不因此断言对方实际违法敲诈。
glossary.example: Maya thought the food-van quote was extortionate.
glossary.exampleZh: 玛雅觉得餐车报价高得离谱。

externalEvidence.definition: greatly exceeding bounds of reason or moderation

glossary.zh: 高到令人无法承担或无法实施地
glossary.note: 通常与expensive/high等连用；强调成本形成实际障碍，不是法律禁止。
glossary.example: The food van is prohibitively expensive for our budget.
glossary.exampleZh: 按我们的预算，这辆餐车贵得租不起。

glossary.note: unsuitable for + 用途或人；外套有别的用处，并非全面差。
glossary.example: The light coat is unsuitable for a cold November walk.
glossary.exampleZh: 薄外套不适合十一月寒冷天气里步行。

externalEvidence.definition: not meant or adapted for a particular purpose

retrievalPrompts.cue: Describe the people and goods at the market to someone who has not been there.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 向没有来过的人介绍集市的卖家和货物。

checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法
